title: Program graph node contract
description: Every node in PROGRAM_GRAPH.json must satisfy this contract. The schema is enforced by scripts/validate_graph.py, which implements it directly and does not require the jsonschema package to be installed.

id.description: Unique stable id. Never reused, never renamed. A superseded node keeps its id and gains status SUPERSEDED.

status.description: Declared seed status only. The AUTHORITATIVE status is derived by graphctl.py state from GRAPH_EVENTS.jsonl plus dependency closure. Where the two disagree, the derived value governs and validate_graph.py reports the divergence.

dependencies.description: Node ids that must reach PASSED (or SUPERSEDED-by-a-passed-successor) before this node becomes READY.

input_artifacts.description: Repository-relative paths this node consumes as evidence. Each must be hashed into ARTIFACT_LEDGER.jsonl and frozen BEFORE the node's agent is launched.

input_hashes.description: path -> sha256, frozen at launch. Empty at seed time; populated by the input-frozen event. Rederived at validation; a mismatch fails the node.

forbidden_inputs.description: Paths the node's agent must not read. For scientific ideation nodes this is the structural independence guarantee and is enforced by physical isolation, not by instruction alone.

allowed_write_paths.description: Path prefixes this node may write. No agent may broaden its own write scope. Enforced at integration by scripts/integrate_node.py against the actual changed-file list.

owned_files.description: Exact files this node owns. Two nodes that are simultaneously RUNNING may never share an owned file or an overlapping allowed_write_path. Enforced by dispatch_ready.py.

epistemic_status.description: What kind of evidence this node's output is, and what it is NOT. Free text, but must be present and must not be empty: a node whose evidential standing is unstated cannot be integrated.

validation_commands.description: Commands run by a verifier context, not by the implementing agent. All must exit 0.

acceptance_criteria.description: Each entry states a machine-verifiable condition. A node may pass automatically only when every criterion is machine-verifiable; otherwise merge_policy must be coordinator or never.

stop_conditions.description: Conditions under which the node halts rather than completing. A tripped stop condition is a HALTED event, never a silent scope reduction.

severity_on_failure.description: A stops the affected descendants. B automatically creates a remediation node. C is documented and scheduled without halting unrelated work. Per RESEARCH_CONTRACT_V1, only Severity A interrupts unaffected parallel work.

merge_policy.description: auto: integrate on all validators passing plus an independent verifier. coordinator: a coordinator context must adjudicate. never: output is evidence only and is not merged as authority.

human_gate.description: True only for nodes whose decision is reserved to the user under GRAPH_POLICY.md section 6. A human_gate node must carry status USER_REQUIRED.

invariants_enforced_beyond_this_schema: every id in dependencies, on_pass and on_fail resolves to a declared node
no two nodes that can be READY at the same time share an owned_file or an overlapping allowed_write_path
no allowed_write_path intersects a frozen path listed in GRAPH_POLICY.md section 3
human_gate true implies status USER_REQUIRED and merge_policy never
merge_policy auto implies at least one validation_command and at least one acceptance_criterion
an experiment-type node depends, transitively, on a frozen preregistration node
